# 佛說分別緣生經

**ID:** T0718
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 宋 法天譯
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 973
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0718

## Contributors
- 法天 (A000690)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T718 in one fascicle is the Northern Sòng translation of a short Mahāyāna sūtra on dependent-origination by [法天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A4%A9) (Dharmadeva, d. 1001), produced at the Sòng *Yìjīngyuàn* 譯經院. The date bracket 982–1001 reflects [法天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A4%A9)'s active period at the Institute for the Translation of Sūtras from its inauguration (Tàipíng Xīngguó 7) to his death.

**Abstract**

The text is a brief exposition of the twelve nidāna chain in the standard Mahāyāna formulation. The Buddha addresses the bodhisattvas, articulating the discrimination (*fēnbié* 分別 = *vibhāga*) of the twelve links. The text is doctrinally close to the *Pratītyasamutpādasūtra* tradition (cf. [KR6i0413](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0413) / T719 *Shíèr yuánshēng xiángruì jīng* by [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)) and represents the Sòng-period canonical taste for short, doctrinally-anchored sūtras suitable for liturgical and pedagogical use.

The text is one of a cluster of late tenth-century Sòng renderings of short Indian *pratītyasamutpāda*-themed sūtras: [KR6i0412](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0412) / T718 (this work), [KR6i0413](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0413) / T719 (Dānapāla), [KR6i0419](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0419) / T725 (Fǎtiān), [KR6i0420](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0420) / T726, [KR6i0421](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0421) / T727, etc. The cluster reflects an apparent Sòng programme of canonical completeness: rendering all the short Indian doctrinal sūtras the bureau could obtain.
